title: Jabali Panel Identity
description: JSON Schema for Kratos identity traits in Jabali Panel

email.title: Email
email.description: Contact email (may be shared across accounts; not used for login).

username.title: Username
username.description: Your account login name (unique). Not your email.

is_admin.title: Administrator
is_admin.description: Whether this identity has admin privileges. Settable only via Admin API.
